title: [4K] Busy Sunday Night Walk Before Christmas at Busan Station
description:
Filmed on 18/12/2022
Entry time: 8:10pm

I had the opportunity to visit Busan Station on a Sunday night, a week before Christmas, and see people travelling and arriving back home. Follow me along the way and find out what Busan Station is like on a Sunday night!
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

TIMESTAMPS ⏱️
0:00 Highlights
1:24 Outside of Busan Station
3:14 Inside the Station
8:26 View 1 of the Crowd
10:03 View 2 of the Crowd
11:52 View 3 of the Crowd
13:15 View of Busan Harbour Bridge
14:52 Back Inside
17:40 Train Arrival / Departure (Busy Time)
23:39 Exit
